text:
ana_partnerops: Quick heads-up from vendor sync: NVIDIA reported a regression in H100 microcode that can increase tail latency for long-context batches. They propose a patch but asked for an extra 48h of soak in our inference images before public announcement. Request: consider delaying joint announce by ~10-14 days or gate marketplace listing to SI-only.

sam_platform: Understood. Is this limited to H100 or will H200/B200 be impacted?

lei_hw: So far isolated to H100 firmware path. H200/B200 unaffected; MI300 and Gaudi also clean. Vendor will push patch today; we should run a 48h inference soak with our typical seq distribution + KV-cache heavy traces.

maria_pm: If we shift embargo, marketing needs new PR slots. Can we do a soft SI-only embargo so SIs get access for integration but public press waits?

ana_partnerops: (typo, meant ana_partnerops) Vendor ok with staged unlocking: SI partners + marketplace sandbox, full public list after signoff.

simon_sales: For Dedicated customers with H100 pinned, ops risk: they'll hit coverage gaps. Can we auto-fallback to MI300 quantized variant for reserved pools while we validate? Need legal note on short exception.

sam_platform: We can create a routing policy to fallback pinned requests to MI300-q8 variants for non-critical workloads. Must notify accounts. Also need to ensure model weights/ops are compatible.

lei_hw: Lab run checklist:
```
- build canary image: redwood-canary-v2026-05-fw1
- deploy canary to staging US+EU
- run 48h inference soak (mixed seq, kv-heavy)
- capture latency tail, mem spikes, kv integrity
- upload traces for vendor review
```

lei_hw: Starting canary tonight; ETA results ~48-60h.

maria_pm: OK, I'll reserve alternative press windows and hold creative. Will draft a brief customer-facing note for sales to use if needed.

ana_partnerops: Draft handoff summary: 
```
- issue: H100 microcode regression (vendor)
- impact: possible delay to marketplace/public announce; SI onramp can proceed gated
- mitigations: MI300 fallback routing for pinned customers; canary soak; vendor patch review
- owners: lei_hw (lab), sam_platform (routing), maria_pm (comms), simon_sales (customer ops)
- next sync: vendor+Redwood embargo check-in in 48-72h
```

simon_sales: I'll flag top reserved accounts and prep email templates in #support. Want to avoid surprise tickets.

deploy-bot: deploy started: marketplace/canary-image -> staging (CI #78901) at 2026-05-18T03:10Z.

sam_platform: Ops note: also add ephemeral SKU tag `canary/h100-fw-patch` and a rollback playbook. I'll open infra ticket.

maria_pm: Let's reconvene with vendor on 2026-05-20 16:00 PT to decide final embargo. If soak looks good early we may keep original PR, otherwise shift.

ana_partnerops: booked vendor call and cc'd SI leads. I'll post soak links here when available. Short updates only for next 72h.
